regions.region: title, abstract, and introduction in the upper and middle page
regions.finding: High-level claims and cited prior work were classified as narrative/literature context, not duplicated as present-paper experiments.
Generic present-paper coupling–cyclization map classified as a general scheme with unresolved R groups.
Eight solvent-screening trials were separated: five solvents failed to afford 3a and three solvents gave only a shared 27–31% yield range.

unresolved: The individual DMA/DMF/DMPU yields are not assigned within the reported 27–31% range.
The introduction cites prior reactions without experiment-level conditions; no literature-example records were fabricated from citation prose.

regions.region: upper-left Scheme 2 and surrounding optimization prose
regions.finding: The DMSO/no-BF3 46% NMR case and BF3-optimized 63% NMR case were separated; qualitative Sc(OTf)3/TFA and PdCl2/PdBr2 comparisons were retained with missing exact yields.

regions.region: middle Table 1 including reaction header and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine independent substrate-scope rows extracted with isolated yields and row-specific time or allenol-2-equivalent overrides.

regions.region: lower Table 2 including reaction header and footnotes
regions.finding: Ten independent E-selective substrate-scope rows extracted with isolated yields, the shared 0.5–1.2 h time range, and entry-1 1.3-equivalent override.

regions.region: upper-right proposed-mechanism prose and lower-left optical-activity discussion
regions.finding: Mechanistic narrative was linked to Scheme 4 as a mechanism record; the two optically active experiments were linked to their page-3 scheme/procedures rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Sc(OTf)3, TFA, PdCl2, and PdBr2 comparison trials have no exact yields or complete conditions in the covered main text.
Table 2 supplies only a shared 0.5–1.2 h range, not row-specific times.
All drawn candidate structures remain unverified.

regions.finding: Two enantioenriched-(S)-1b coupling experiments extracted and merged with their detailed paragraphs; product ee and isolated yields retained.
Four-arrow oxypalladation/carbopalladation/beta-hydroxide-elimination/catalyst-regeneration proposal classified as mechanism, not experiment.

regions.region: lower-left Experimental Section and page-spanning 3a general procedure
regions.finding: Starting-material preparations are citation-based and were not expanded; the complete 3a procedure was merged into Table 1 entry 1 with quantities, workup, purification, product mass, and yield.
Exact masses, amounts, catalyst loadings, solvent volumes, product masses, ee, optical rotations, and HPLC-condition narrative were localized; no new duplicate records were made.

unresolved: The 3j paragraph explicitly pairs 56.0 mg of (S)-1b with 1.00 mmol; this apparent source inconsistency is preserved.
The optical-activity procedures omit reaction time, atmosphere, workup, and purification.

regions.region: both columns of the original page
regions.finding: References and publication dates only; cited prior work was not converted into present-paper experiments because no experiment-specific arrows, conditions, or outcomes appear on this page.

unresolved: No SI file was supplied or explicitly associated; the reference page does not establish an SI association.
